sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Security Assessment Policy defines the requirements for evaluating and monitoring the effectiveness of security controls for {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to the system boundary defined as {boundary} and ensures the protection of Controlled Unclassified Information, specifically {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Security Control Assessment

questions.prompt: How often are security controls periodically assessed?
What methods are used to determine if controls are effective in their application?

sections.body: Security controls for {system_name} are periodically assessed every {assessment_frequency}. The effectiveness of these controls is determined using {assessment_method}.

sections.heading: 3. Remediation and Plans of Action

questions.prompt: How are plans of action developed to correct deficiencies?
How are these plans implemented to reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities?

sections.body: Deficiencies identified during assessments are addressed through {poam_process}. These plans are implemented to reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities via {vulnerability_reduction}.

sections.heading: 4. Ongoing Security Monitoring

questions.prompt: What mechanisms are used to monitor security controls on an ongoing basis?

sections.body: To ensure the continued effectiveness of security controls, {org_name} utilizes {monitoring_mechanism} for ongoing monitoring of {system_name}.

sections.heading: 5. System Security Plan (SSP) Management

questions.prompt: How frequently is the System Security Plan (SSP) reviewed and updated?
How does the SSP describe the system boundaries, environments, and implementation of security requirements?

sections.body: The System Security Plan for {system_name} is documented and updated {ssp_update_cycle}. The SSP provides a detailed description of the system boundary ({boundary}), the operational environment, and the implementation of security requirements as detailed in {ssp_content_description}.
